description: Add One UI from Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or VS Code. One registry in components.json, then ask for any component.

registry.heading: Add the registry
registry.body: Your project needs shadcn set up first: `components.json`, Tailwind, and the `cn` helper. Add this to `components.json` and keep `{name}` as written.

ask.heading: Ask for a component
ask.body: Prefix the name with `@one-ui`, or ask in plain words. The file lands in `components/ui`, and it's yours from there.

clients.claude: Run this in your project, then restart Claude Code. `/mcp` should list shadcn as connected.
clients.cursor: Run this in your project, then enable shadcn in Cursor's MCP settings.
clients.vscode: Run this in your project, then open `.vscode/mcp.json` and click Start next to shadcn.
clients.codex: Codex can't write its own config. Add this to `~/.codex/config.toml`, then restart Codex.

askPrompt: Add the fluid orb from One UI
withoutBody: The shadcn CLI installs the same files. Browse everything on the <link>components</link> page.
